a.lede: The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed exec with whom Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair, is a Chinese spy.
a.title: Is Alice Huang a spy or not?

b.lede: Jensen Huang admitted to more affairs than the two that Nvidia's board members were already aware of before they agreed to let him return to the company as CEO, President, and board member, amid reports that one of the women involved is a Chinese spy.
b.title: Jensen Huang confessed to more affairs before the board reinstated him as Nvidia CEO, report claims
